name: Pavías (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, red and green, the middle of double width, charged with a peacock in its pride.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 19 September 2003 of the conseller de Justícia, Interior i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 4609 of 16 October 2003; it is a flag of 2:3, tierced horizontally with the second third of double width, the outer thirds vert and the central gules charged with a peacock proper in its pride, based on the colours of the arms (approved 28 June 2002).

features.role: peacock in its pride, the canting figure
